instructions.purpose: Fill this file with real risk acceptance evidence, then pass it as DDD_ROLLBACK_DRILL_DEFERRAL_FILE to scripts/ddd-rollback-drill-evidence.mjs.
instructions.safety: Do not use this template to bypass rollback drills. DEFERRED is accepted only with a real reason, named risk acceptor, concrete evidence reference, and future expiresAt.
instructions.evidence: deferralEvidence must reference an approval ticket, change record, meeting note, artifact/log path, HTTPS link, or object URI.
